Escape the Backrooms is a disappointment. Genuinely, it had potential and was one of my favorite games at some point, but to say it has fallen off would be an understatement.

I've been playing the game for a genuine while now, spent hours speedrunning and doing achievements with friends and by myself.
And the game wasn't perfect before, the animations were clunky, the level design was kinda bad, some levels clearly made by a beginner dev, but it had some promising ambiance and banger sound design/soundtracks.

I kinda forgot, since it was long ago, but didn't the dev say he'd redo the old levels after having made the old ones? Because the old levels are absolute garbage to play through?
Most streamers quit at the same exact place, the Hotel, specifically the labyrinth with the moths, which, let's be honest, the heat system serves nothing, and 80% of people just watched a speedrun to know the route.
The dev also started promising this redoing of the old levels by posting screenshots of a revamped "The End" level, which looked gorgeous. All that for what? For this new "revamped" room to only serve as a room that opens after you finish The End, and it didn't change at ALL btw, AH NAH now the lights go out, as if this part didn't suck enough with the monster randomly walking onto you. Like, ♥♥♥♥ just looks out of place, and the genuine box that used to be the original level is, well, still the current level.
And most levels have ♥♥♥♥ like this, stuff that should be fixed, or were promised to change, but nope. Lots of potential, lots of "oh yeah it just needs polishing", and yup, never polished, only added more onto the pile.

The fun glitches get fixed, thoses used by speedrunners that no beginner player would ever find, yup, fixed. The dev even wanted to patch ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ bhop at some point, but didn't due to community backlash.
And the glitches that are EVERYWHERE in the game, or simply the levels that are designed so poorly it feels like it was made by a monkey jumping on a keyboard.
And the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ Nightmare achievement, yeah with the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ ass level design, it's almost impossible, except if you know glitches, but some of them do get patched, even tho, again, no beginner would ever find those, but sure. BUT! I just have hatred towards multiplayer achievements, especially when like, nightmare is already hard enough, with the ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ glitches too, but FOUR PLAYERS?? The cave level with the monsters that roam around, you get seen? Yeah goodluck you're dead 9 times out of 10. It was fun doing tries with friends, but most fun glitches got patched, and we just, lost interest in this.

And yeah, the animations still suck, the models are kinda bad in general, the guy made a ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ of money and could've commissionned or hired 3D artists and level designers, but what did he do instead? Sell his game. I ain't believing the original guy still has anything to do with the development except like, maybe giving directions or doing the community management and advertisement.

This game is a genuine moneyprinter, and now they've got paid skin DLCs? And what, they're gonna add NEW levels instead of fixing the buffoonery that is their game currently?

I've played this game for 240 hours, 240 ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ hours, speedrunning and doing achievements, I know most levels like the back of my hand by now. And I can genuinely tell you, please for the love of god don't buy this game. Well, most backrooms games were made as cashgrabs because putting a texture on walls and a ScArY monster was easy enough, and I've yet to see a single backrooms game that has actual efforts and passion put into it. WAIT NO there's The Backworld that does something actually interesting with the concept, seemingly at least, hyped to see how it'll end up. If anyone has actually good backrooms game, please comment, I'd love to know.

Anyways, ♥♥♥♥ this game, a pile of ♥♥♥♥ with whipped cream on top, and they keep adding more with useless skins and new levels that bloat the game without ever making the core and first levels (aka the first half of the game) actually good.

If I could get a refund, I would.

Escape the Backrooms is a great game to play for the first time, I cannot highly recommend it to people who like backroom stuff. I have played Escape the Backrooms since the second major update and I've watched Fancy's devlogs when there were only two of them on youtube. It doesn't have the best replayability but I still somehow keep on coming back. It is incredibly sad to see what has happened to this game ever since the solo dev Fancy gave away his game to secret mode. (who btw have an ongoing lawsuit against them for hijacking a different developers game) Ever since Secret Mode took over, the game has gone downhill. Oh they added a new patch! What is it? Its skins… and minor bug fixes… at least they aren't paid skins. (yet) Oh another patch! Is there a new level? Oh… more skins… and that's it. More skins and a couple bug fixes. When consoles first got released the game was unplayable if you had two or more players, they added a patch that made your sensitivity based on your FPS. The higher your FPS the slower your sens was. They added skins to the game, something fancy was opposed to adding at first. When their first level (Level 421) was added. It was clearly not playtested. In Fun+ in the same update that added 421, some of the plastic balls in the room you start in were missing, and the best part is that if you tried to enter the level in hub mode it would send you back to the lobby! At the very least that “update” reverted the FPS sensitivity issue. (which wasn't fixed for months) And now they are adding DLC for paid skins!!! Isn't that nice? You get to waste money on backroom skins that you can't even see much of since you're in first person. If they are adding paid skins, there's a good chance there will be paid levels that are also broken and not playtested. I still do advise buying this game, but I wouldn't expect any more good updates to ever come from it again. Unless they somehow turn everything around like with gearbox and RoR2. But that is very unlikely. RIP Escape the Backrooms.

It goes from doing fun and challenging puzzles to basically trying to navigate and sneak around hordes of enemies that you will potentially spend hours just being killed over and over again with no clear direction. I had to come back to the final level over the course of three days because it was just really annoying. 

I can say that regardless if you do buy this game you will have at least a week of fun before beating the game and never wanting to play it again. It also has a lot of potential if it got just a little more love but at the present I cannot in good conscious recommend it(especially at full price)

My opinion:

         pros
+ very cool graphics
+ a lot of levels

         cons
- levels are not procedurally generated, only items have a different location every time
- levels lack interesting interactable, everywhere is just props you cannot even punch or something
- monsters are more annoying than scary or interesting, having a simplest mechanics ever


 Notes:
 This game would look insane if it was made like a story cinematic game, but instead it made as game with a bad mechanics that are annoying and made me rage quit instead of getting interested in playing further. 
 Monster chases are just straightforward "run till it loose agroo, or until you run into a room and close a door behind yourself". 
 Also this game have a useless mechanics such as sanity which is literally like an trivial hunger bar for a single level; and "show your worker id", which you will not need because the monsters that disguised as workers are not even trying to somehow act like players, they just straightforward start running at you when they spot you. 
 Animations are wacky, are breaking immersion
 The characters skins are breaking immersion
 Interactions with monsters are quite bad readable (like, its hard to tell when you stun a monster or when he is not chasing you anymore, or what you should do to make it stop chasing you)
 Levels lack interesting items to play with or find to
 The level interactables elements on levels are poorly highlighted so you have to look at every item prop in the level you didn't seen before to understand if its interactable or not


 My conclusion: 
Refunded. 
There is a Roblox maps or Minecraft mods that portrays the backrooms vibes better than this game, because this game would be incredible solo story driven cinematic experience, but made into a coop fast food game instead, what a loss
